product.title: Marcahuasi Experience in Lima

description.text: In Lima, this private full-day outing leaves the coastal districts for San Pedro de Casta and the Marcahuasi Stone Forest. A guide covers the off-road approach and the high plateau walk among the stone formations, with breakfast listed on the product page. Pickup is published for Lima Metropolitana so the group can stay with the plateau rather than self-driving mountain roads. The day is aimed at visitors who want a guided jeep-and-hike window without renting a 4x4 independently. Altitude and walking time still depend on conditions on the plateau. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on San Pedro de Casta and the Marcahuasi Stone Forest that shape this inland day rather than a city-plaza or island add-on.
